newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - ADM downgraded to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - ADM downgraded to hold.

text.p: -- Dain Bosworth analyst Bonnie Wittenburg said Friday she downgraded Archer Daniels Midland Co to a hold from a buy rating.

-- She also cut her earnings estimate for fiscal 1997 to $1.23 a share from $1.50, which compares with the $1.27 it earned in fiscal 1996. She reduced her fiscal 1998 estimate to $1.40 a share from $1.80.
"Although we're told that negotiations are underway regarding HFCS (high fructose corn syrup) contracts, the outlook for profits appears to be worsening," Wittenburg wrote in a report.
-- High fructose corn syrup, a sweetener used in foods and beverages, is ADM's single most important product, Wittenburg said.

-- "The industry is plagued by overcapacity, but as recently as earlier this week, we were picking up information that continued to cause us to believe that HFCS margins likely would be flattish with last year," Wittenburg said.
-- While contracts are still being negotiated, indications are that margins for suppliers are likely to be worse than a year ago, she added.
